description: Random-shape ramp otti tile from Pak Clay, a concrete outdoor floor tile. Irregular pieces are laid together like a mosaic, giving a textured, crazy-paving look for ramps, slopes and driveways. Shades vary between pieces, so view a sample and plan the layout before fixing. Prepare a firm, sloped base for drainage, ask your fixer about the right bedding, and order the full quantity from one batch with a margin for cuts. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
